llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed brand narrative registry that reads and writes local canon records through a host-controlled workflow, with no artifact evidence of hidden or harmful behavior.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to record, query, and version a brand narrative canon; the described reads from narrative memory, projections, claims evidence, and proposals, plus writes to narrative events and generated views, fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions require user authorization before writes, treat drafts as untrusted proposals, reject stale or partial updates, and avoid direct NDJSON edits; no prompt override, hidden command, or unrelated behavior is present.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains a single markdown SKILL.md and no executable scripts or install-time code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill depends on an external host runtime, registry script, schema, and catalog, and resolves a skills root via CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT or git root; this is disclosed and bounded to the registry workflow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It uses append-only narrative events and generated memory views, which are persistent local state changes, but it explicitly requires permission, host capability checks, expected revisions, and avoids logging capability values.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to manage a persistent, versioned brand narrative canon in your local skill memory. Review the host registry runtime it depends on, because actual writes occur through that external capability-controlled mechanism rather than code included in this package.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact review found no contradictory evidence.
[Static scan clean result] expected: Static scan reported no findings, consistent with the single non-executable markdown artifact.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: VirusTotal reported no malicious or suspicious engines; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
